cards.soWhat: Apple Search Ads is the stronger paid acquisition source at $15.03 per user and 32.1% pay, while TikTok Ads is low value at $5.09 with high refunds. Shift budget from TikTok Ads to Apple Search Ads and pause or tighten TikTok targeting until refund quality improves.
Day-one users who make 5+ AI edits are the highest-value behavior segment at $15.21 per user and 32.4% pay. Optimize onboarding and paid traffic toward getting users to 5+ edits on day one.
NL, US, DE, SE, and GB are the strongest markets at $12–15 per user, while IN, TR, and MX are much weaker. Prioritize paid acquisition in the stronger markets and reduce spend in IN, TR, and MX.
Product photos users from Apple Search Ads are the best segment here, with 39.5% paying and $19.61 per user. Build dedicated Apple Search Ads campaigns and creatives around product photos.

The Settings test picked the wrong winner: main_lifetime has higher pay rate and revenue per user, with a significant paid-rate lift. Switch the winner to main_lifetime and use it for acquisition traffic.
